findings.description: `HelpdeskClient.request` renamed its `attempts` parameter to `max_attempts`. This call site was not updated, so `attempts=1` now falls into `**fields` and is sent as `{"attempts": 1}` in the ticket body. The non-idempotent POST also loses its single-attempt protection and uses the default of 3 attempts. A timeout or 5xx will retry and can create duplicate tickets. The vendor API may also reject the unknown field.
findings.suggestion: Change `attempts=1` to `max_attempts=1`. Also grep for any other callers still using `attempts=`.
findings.title: create_ticket still passes the renamed `attempts` kwarg, so it becomes a JSON body field
